scope: POSIX npm global Kimi entry resolution and native-launcher preservation
Canonical edit approval paths and unchanged one-shot ownership/scope consumption
Existing Kimi e2e and real-CLI local-model probe containment

findings.finding: POSIX global npm bin/kimi is not mapped to prefix/lib/node_modules; ACP compatibility never attaches and real Glob/Grep fail
findings.resolution: Recognize standard global symlink only if launcher and npm entry have equal realpaths; preserve Windows/local branches

findings.finding: Canonical host fs path differs from lexical native Write path, causing a second approval
findings.resolution: Use existing realpathForContainment before showing/storing native edit approval; preserve consume ownership and once/session rules

findings.finding: Naive global path lookup could replace a native launcher when an old npm package exists nearby
findings.resolution: Require launcher-to-entry realpath identity; existing e2e covers ordinary native launcher alongside stale package

independentValidation.pathBoundary: Missing file under an aliased existing directory maps to same canonical target; no change to tier/toolCallId/settled/once/session/ambiguity conditions or final fs guard
independentValidation.probeBoundary: Canonicalizes mkdtemp and temporary root together; no expanded cleanup scope
independentValidation.reviewerExecution: Static code and assertion review, no concurrent tests or real CLI account access

unverified: Real-account Kimi service round, stop and recovery
Formal login Keychain authorization and Windows same-SHA runtime
completionChecklistReview: Mac credential contract (isolated Keychain and denied IPC scope), local business/capabilities, explicit unverified environments and evidence tracking are proven; V05/V07 complete and Windows same-SHA remain open.
